title: Review hardcoded secret
why: Literal credentials committed in source can leak through version history, packages, logs, and deployed artifacts.
suggestion: Load real credentials from a secret provider or runtime configuration; use an obvious placeholder in examples.
limitations: Only literal statement-level assignments and literal map entries with credential-like names are recognized.

Dynamic f-strings, keyword arguments, symbolic values, documentation labels and references, embedded JSON examples, test placeholders, UI relabeling and placeholder metadata, and non-alphanumeric account markers are excluded.
